The current worktree declares the patched `0.62.5` line and lock entry; retain `default-features = false` plus exactly the `ring` leaf. The unused compression and RSA leaves are forbidden: this tunnel does not negotiate compression, and RSA remains excluded until its remote-observable timing advisory has an upstream constant-time fix; do not misclassify an outbound SSH client as local-only. TOFU identity is host-wide: once any host-key algorithm is pinned for a host, an unseen algorithm for that host must fail closed while exact legacy pins remain usable. The independent review of `russh 0.62.4` found that it serialized password authentication into a debug-logged packet buffer and retained its plain `String` authentication method after success. The advisory patch to `russh 0.62.5` does not by itself re-authorize production password authentication; it must therefore remain fail-closed until a reviewed upstream/forked implementation both removes the packet dump and zeroizes/drops the method on every terminal path. Private-key authentication remains the supported client path and must prove encrypted OpenSSH-key/passphrase behavior. `ssh-tunnel` is a source-build opt-in absent from `default`, `release-desktop` and `release-server`; the CI feature matrix must locked-build it on Ubuntu and run its focused hermetic transport tests without silently adding SSH to stock release bundles. Current local evidence: feature-on Windows test compilation; post-fix exact **11/11** password/private-key/jump/reconnect/keychain-publication proofs; no audit vulnerability; locked all-feature deny green; exact notices current. The later authority review also requires successful keychain open/read before a missing compound bundle may authorize legacy fallback; its byte-exact unavailable-store regression is present but remains runtime-pending because the first invocation selected 0 tests. This child is still **OPEN** until exact-head CI and the final integration/full-release gate runs that regression and records the broader matrix; repeated broad local Cargo/Clippy passes are deliberately deferred until feature and wiring construction is complete. No advisory ignore or dismissal is permitted. This required child keeps WS-R3 at **19 total / 6 open / 13 done** until R3-10 closes.

Bind content through an account-scoped cipher/key reference, quotas and retention; WAL receives content-free metadata/receipts only. **Depends on:** `GOLD-CC-01` and typed `InstancePaths`. **Done:** malformed existing state never becomes empty success; cross-account/subject reads fail closed; atomic batch plus cursor commit is idempotent; crash-after-DB-before-WAL is reconciled through a durable audit outbox; complete account purge removes eligible evidence, derived rows, cursor state and key material while retaining only policy-allowed content-free receipts.

items.section: WS-CC — Context Connectors & People Intelligence (1.0 GOLD)
items.body: **GOLD-CC-02a Receipt-ledger freshness authority and snapshot-rollback resistance:** bind every committed Context Evidence receipt-ledger head to an authenticated, non-filesystem `ReceiptFreshnessAnchor` that atomically compare-and-advances `(instance_id, ledger_key_id, generation, manifest_digest)`. A local HMAC, DPAPI, Keychain or file anchor alone is not a freshness authority against a complete coordinated local snapshot rollback and may never be described as one. The selected production anchor must be independently rollback-resistant on every supported release platform, or use a pinned authenticated remote authority; unavailable, stale, lower-generation, mismatched-instance/key/head, replayed or indeterminate anchor state blocks receipt ACK/admission and is surfaced as a typed degraded state. **Depends on:** `GOLD-CC-01`, `GOLD-CC-02`, typed `InstancePaths` and the bounded Context Evidence receipt-ledger primitive. **Done:** local pending evidence is durable before external-anchor advance; restart and recovery either materialize the exact anchored candidate or fail closed; initialization, append, restart, torn local commit, torn anchor advance, same-process and cross-process contention, key replacement/loss, manifest/shard replay and complete coordinated local-directory snapshot restore are covered; an older local snapshot cannot ACK or append against a newer anchor; supported Windows, macOS and Linux anchors have real qualification evidence; CLI, GUI, Buddy and Doctor expose one truthful configured/healthy/degraded contract; no unconfigured local-only fallback claims full-snapshot rollback protection.

A ledger-only receipt may not become durable security evidence that the operator cannot inspect or export. Pin ledger-v1 as the first production emission format and route any manually injected or unreleased historical primary-WAL `0x27` frame through an explicit offline forensic migration path rather than silently treating it as absent or duplicating it. **Depends on:** `GOLD-CC-02` and the bounded Context Evidence receipt-ledger primitive. **Done:** readers validate manifest, shard, handle/payload, generation and anchor bindings with fixed directory, byte, allocation and output limits; primary-WAL and ledger evidence have one deterministic ordered/exported representation without a full-home retained-payload scan; signed exports bind the exact ledger head and receipt set; tamper, rollback, collision, missing key/anchor, legacy-primary-only evidence, output truncation and concurrent append fixtures fail closed or report a typed incomplete result; CLI, GUI, Buddy, Doctor and audit consumers expose the same content-free receipt truth; a source-wide inventory/allowlist regression fails if any current or newly introduced receipt/audit output path bypasses the unified reader.

items.section: WS-CC — Context Connectors & People Intelligence (1.0 GOLD)

Operator identity, authenticated channel sender identity and inferred external people remain separate namespaces. **Depends on:** `GOLD-CC-02` and `GOLD-CC-04`. **Done:** weak-signal collisions never auto-merge; private/business/subject boundaries are enforced; merge, split, source removal and account erasure rebuild all affected projections deterministically with provenance and without orphaned facts.

items.section: WS-CC — Context Connectors & People Intelligence (1.0 GOLD)
items.body: **GOLD-CC-06 Evidence-based extraction and safe Context projection:** run deterministic parsers before any explicitly consented model extraction; every claim, commitment, date, project or relationship retains source span, confidence, extractor version, policy revision and revocation/expiry state. External text remains typed untrusted data with no system, skill, tool, memory-promotion or action authority. **Depends on:** `GOLD-CC-05`, `GOLD-R3-14` and the applicable NCT content/projector contract before provider delivery. **Done:** adversarial HTML/mail/chat/attachment instructions, nested delimiters, Unicode/control obfuscation, stale/retracted sources, model failure and replay remain data-only; every displayed claim exposes evidence and correction/removal controls; only reviewed/corroborated projections may enter existing GroundTruth/recall consumers.

items.body: **JARVIS-ADOPT-02 — Ein Capture-/Talk-Owner mit begrenzter Audio-Uebergabe:** Jarvis `voice.py` sowie Android `VoiceWakeManager`, `TalkAudioPlayer`, `TalkSpeakClient` und `ChatRealtimeTalk` sind Quellvorbilder, keine NEOTH-Abnahme. Ueberlappende Capture-Owner werden abgelehnt; Abbruch gibt Lease und Puffer frei, spaete Frames/Antwortaudio werden per Session-ID verworfen. items.section: W2556 — Jarvis-Geraeteadoption: belegte Vorbilder, offene NEOTH-Slices (2026-10-12)
items.body: **JARVIS-ADOPT-03 — Deterministische Sieben-Sekunden-Stille:** Die 7.000-ms-Regel ist eine angeforderte NEOTH-Produktentscheidung, kein bestaetigter Jarvis-Quellwert. Sie misst nur qualifizierte Sprachframes mit monotoner Uhr und Session-ID, nie Heartbeats, UI-Updates oder Tool-Fortschritt. Ablauf erzeugt genau einmal `silence_timeout` und finalisiert oder kehrt in armed/idle zurueck. Akzeptanz: Sprache bei 6,9 Sekunden setzt nur die aktuelle Session zurueck; ein alter Timer darf keine Ersatzsession beenden; ohne akzeptiertes Transkript wird kein Gehoert-Anspruch erzeugt.

UI leitet Autoritaet nie aus Modellprosa ab. Akzeptanz: realer Fehler rendert failed, nicht gestarteter Subagent bleibt unknown/not-started, doppelte oder ungeordnete Ereignisse konvergieren; Geheimnisse, Prompts, Rohoutput und private URLs bleiben ausgeschlossen.

items.body: **JARVIS-ADOPT-06 — Kamera PiP/Fullscreen/Audio/Listen koexistenz:** Android `RingCallPresentation`, `RingWebRtcSession`, `CameraCaptureManager`, `CameraHandler` und `ChatCameraActivity` geben den Quellrahmen. Ein lease-gebundener Zustandsautomat nutzt preview/PiP, fullscreen, connecting, connected, ending, closed. Vor Implementierung ist zu entscheiden und am Zielgeraet zu beweisen, ob Call-Audio Sprache/Listen verdrängt oder eine konkrete Duplex-Route traegt; Mikrofon wird nie implizit geteilt. Akzeptanz: PiP-zu-Fullscreen, Fehler/Disconnect/Timeout/Dismissal-Freigabe sowie Voice-Block oder nachgewiesenes Duplex. Der vorhandene Jarvis-Quelltest ist kein physischer NEOTH-Beleg.

items.section: W2556 — Jarvis-Geraeteadoption: belegte Vorbilder, offene NEOTH-Slices (2026-10-12)
items.body: **JARVIS-ADOPT-07 — Ring-/Tuer-Call mit 30-Sekunden-Abschluss:** Android `HomeDashboardCameraRecoveryDeviceTest` und `JarvisRingAlertDeviceTest` belegen lokal Ring- und Alert-Grenzen, nicht NEOTH-Geraeteverhalten. Ein authentifiziertes, dedupliziertes Ereignis erwirbt genau Alert-/Camera-Lease; monotone 30 Sekunden, Nutzer-Dismissal und Verbindungsende geben View, Kamera und Audio frei. Wiederholtes Ereignis aktualisiert den bestehenden Call und stapelt keine Ansicht. Akzeptanz: ein Event/ein Alert, Dedupe, 30-s-Freigabe bei nicht verfuegbarer UI und keine Ueberschreibung eines fremden Voice-Gespraechs. Modelltext darf keinen Tuer-Call erzeugen.

items.section: W2556 — Jarvis-Geraeteadoption: belegte Vorbilder, offene NEOTH-Slices (2026-10-12)
items.body: **JARVIS-ADOPT-08 — Ankuendigungen und Raum-Medien mit exakten Ziel-Receipts:** Android `AlexaAnnouncement*`, `JarvisAnnouncementChime`, `JarvisMedia*` sowie Pi-Media-Snapshot sind Vorbilder. Bestehende NEOTH-Connector-/Effect-Pfade erhalten nur fehlende `announce`/`route_media`-Bindings: aufgeloestes Ziel, Idempotenzschluessel, Annahme-Receipt, Geraeteausgang und Terminalstatus. Mehrdeutige Ziele brauchen eine exakte Aufloesung. Akzeptanz: gleicher Key spielt nicht erneut; offline/unsupported bleibt sichtbarer Nicht-Erfolg; played/announced folgt erst Completion-Receipt. Nachrichtengroesse, Telemetrie und Retry bleiben begrenzt; unklarer Effekt wird vor Retry kanonisch abgeglichen.

items.section: W2556 — Jarvis-Geraeteadoption: belegte Vorbilder, offene NEOTH-Slices (2026-10-12)
items.body: **JARVIS-ADOPT-09 — begrenzter Routinecache mit ehrlicher Recovery:** Android `ChatTranscriptCache`, `ClientDatabases` sowie Outbox/Ack-Modelle inspirieren nur das Muster. Neben dem bestehenden NEOTH-WAL/Recovery-Owner minimale Aktion-Intention, Korrelation, Zielrevision und autoritativer Receipt/Status halten; kein zweiter Speicher-/Queue-Owner. Reconnect liefert ausschliesslich confirmed/not_started/in_progress/failed/unknown; unknown wird nie blind wiederholt. Akzeptanz: accepted-vor-disconnect erzeugt keinen Duplikatsend, stale Capability wird erkannt, unknown bleibt sichtbar und Restart-Recovery bleibt begrenzt. Kein Cache fuer Audio, Geheimnisse, Volltranskript oder Kamerainhalt.

items.section: W2556 — Jarvis-Geraeteadoption: belegte Vorbilder, offene NEOTH-Slices (2026-10-12)
items.body: **JARVIS-ADOPT-10 — signierte Android-/Pi-OTA hinter einer Release-Grenze:** Android `JarvisAppUpdate*` sowie Pi `publish_ota.py`, `stable.json`, `stable.json.sig` zeigen getrennte Quellen, keinen gemeinsamen NEOTH-Updatevertrag. Ein vorhandener Release-Owner wird, nur falls die Luecke besteht, um Adapter hinter signed manifest, Digest, Zielrestriktion, monotone Version, Ablauf und Rollback-Evidenz erweitert. Vor Staging sind Signatur/Digest/Version/Ziel zu pruefen; Staging geht Aktivierung voraus. Akzeptanz: gueltig staged, manipuliert/falsches Ziel/abgelaufen vor Installation abgelehnt, Unterbrechung behaelt known-good, UI erhaelt belegtes Terminalresultat. Kein Downgrade ausser expliziter Recovery-Regel; keine Hermes-Kompatibilitaetszusage ohne End-to-End-Adapterbeweis.
